effectSummary.ko: 자신의 살아 있는 미끼 3m 안의 적에게 일반 액티브 직접 피해가 가산 10% 증가합니다. 미끼의 폭발 피해에는 적용하지 않습니다.
effectSummary.en: Gain +10% additive normal-active direct damage against enemies within 3m of your living decoy. Does not amplify the decoy's explosion.

productionConcept: An enduring decoy tactics emblem: a small pale hooded decoy bust at center is flanked by two inward pointing broad dark arrowheads, creating a deliberate ambush composition. The decoy is a calm carved spectral effigy, no explosion or full battlefield.
